resources.string: Tap to launch hidden phone radio config
Selecting "NR only" forces 5G Standalone. If your carrier does not support Voice over 5G (VoNR), incoming calls may not ring. Use "NR/LTE" for uninterrupted calls.
NR only: Unlimited 5G speed (Carrier must have 5G SA).
NR / LTE: 5G speed + 4G VoLTE calls fallback (Recommended).
LTE / WCDMA / GSM: Standard automatic switching.
